messages:
sarah.docs: Quick heads-up 1: I opened a PR to refresh SDK snippets for streaming + pagination with the new resume helper. Link: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/pulls/421
david.sdk: Thanks! The helper unifies resume token handling, backoff for transient errors, and TTL semantics. Added Python + TS + Go examples in the PR.
lee.ts: Dropped a small inline comment about the TypeScript types (Generic<T> -> Generic<Result>) so examples compile with strict mode.
marco.go: Pushed a Go snippet showing context cancellation + how to surface transient RetryableCursor errors so callers can fall back to a cheaper model.
anya.qa: Can we get a small e2e snippet that runs the resume flow against the local docs preview so QA can reproduce a TTL-expiry scenario?
ds-pr-review-bot: PR 421: 4 changed files, 6 comments. CI: docs-preview build started.
david.sdk: Good call, anya. I'll add a tiny Node test that simulates the token TTL and asserts the helper returns a RecoverableCursorError.
sarah.docs: Also added migration note "switching from manual cursors to resume helper" and a short checklist for docs owners: update codeblock, link to SDK changelog, run preview locally.
lee.ts: One more: show how to consume streaming outputs while using resumeHelper (stream->parse->yield). I added that snippet.
marco.go: FYI I included a Go example that shows how to wrap resumeHelper in a select loop and cancel on sigterm. Left a TODO to add a small benchmark measuring latency impact.
pr-review-bot: docs-preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/resume-helper-e2e - change set: 1 page updated, snippets: python.ts.go updated
david.sdk: Plan: after docs merge I'll cut a small SDK patch that re-exports resumeHelper at top-level and marks old util as deprecated. We'll coordinate release notes.
sarah.docs: Please squash when merging and use changelog entry: "docs: add resume_helper examples (py/ts/go), migration note, TTL/fallback guidance"
anya.qa: Assigning QA smoke: I'll run the preview and test the TTL scenario tomorrow. If I spot flaky behavior I'll open an issue against the SDK branch.
lee.ts: LGTM besides the few typedoc nits.
file_description: coordination thread for PR updating SDK snippets to use resume helper, migration note, QA steps, TS/Go/Python examples and PR/CI status
